age-trends.unit: Percent of people in the age group, all genders

definitions.Risky drinking: More than 10 standard drinks weekly OR more than 4 on a single day at least monthly, average over previous 12 months; fixed 2020 guideline definition applied to all displayed waves.
definitions.More than 10 drinks weekly: More than 10 standard drinks per week on average in previous 12 months.
definitions.More than 4 drinks monthly: More than 4 standard drinks on one occasion at least once a month over previous 12 months.

age-trends.handling: Original flags preserved. n.p., censored <0.1 and ** estimates unsuitable for most uses have null chart value; original published string retained. Main age bins only, excluding overlapping additional bins and totals.
age-trends.limitations: Repeated cross-sections, not people tracked over time. A wave labelled 2022–2023 has numeric ordering key 2022. # is significance versus 2019 only, not versus2001.

risk-mosaic.definitions: Weekly threshold is >10 standard drinks per week on average. Episodic threshold is >4 drinks on an occasion at least monthly over past12 months. Abstainer is no alcohol in past12 months.
risk-mosaic.source_correction: Footnotes(d)/(e) in Table4.31 reverse the weekly definitions. Followed explicit row labels, independently checked against Table4.27 marginal totals.
risk-mosaic.geometry: Within each gender, x-width is weekly marginal / sum published cells; y-height is cell / weekly marginal. All geometries use0–100 coordinates. Female sum99.9 due to rounding; only geometry normalized, published values unchanged. n.a. structural combinations are omitted, never converted to invented data.

state-risk.unit: Percent of people aged14+ within state and gender
state-risk.definition: Derived from2020 NHMRC guideline1: more than10 standard drinks weekly OR more than4 on a single day at least monthly, on average.
state-risk.notes: Latest2022–2023 wave only. Crude survey prevalence, not age-standardised. Sampled prevalence and ranking have sampling uncertainty. # refers to significant change since2019, not differences between states.

adult-gap.unit: Percent of adults in the corresponding age/sex group
adult-gap.definition: Total exceeded2020 adult guideline: >10 drinks in last week or5+ on any day in last12 months at least monthly. At least monthly interpreted as12+ times in last12 months.
adult-gap.sex_definition: Sex recorded at birth; table uses Males/Females. ABS persons totals can include other terms.
adult-gap.notes: Do not splice this NHS snapshot into NDSHS series. Published cells are randomly adjusted for confidentiality; component sums can differ. moe is a percentage-point margin; rse is percent. Adult total is a summary and must not be summed with age groups.

treatment-states.definition: Closed treatment episodes for own drug use where principal drug of concern is Alcohol.
treatment-states.notes: Counts are episodes, not unique patients. State totals reflect population size, service coverage, access and reporting. Fiscal year uses starting numeric year. No per-capita denominator is provided or inferred.
